meta.name: atlassian-templates
meta.description: Atlassian Template and Files Creator/Modifier expert for creating, modifying, and managing Jira and Confluence templates, blueprints, custom layouts, reusable components, and standardized content structures. Use when building org-wide templates, custom blueprints, page layouts, and automated content generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和管理团队模板与内容结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Jira和Confluence中统一团队模板和内容格式。
copy.tagline_en: Create and manage team templates and content structures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to standardize templates and content in Jira and Confluence.

howto.what: 该技能让Claude能创建、修改和管理Jira与Confluence的模板、蓝图、页面布局等。它会按流程访谈需求、设计结构、生成Confluence存储格式的XHTML（通过内置脚手架），并经MCP把页面部署到指定空间，或在Jira中创建预填模板文本的issue。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建组织级模板、自定义蓝图、页面布局等，或需要自动化内容生成时触发。也适用于修改、管理现有模板。

say.text: 帮我创建会议纪要模板，生成存储格式的XHTML。
say.note: Claude会用脚手架生成并让你确认。

say.text: 把项目章程模板部署到Marketing空间的Confluence。
say.note: 会通过MCP获取资源并创建页面。

say.text: 更新决策日志模板，保留旧版本。
say.note: 会先读取当前版本再更新。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to create, modify, and manage Jira/Confluence templates, blueprints, and layouts. It interviews stakeholders, designs structures, generates Confluence storage-format XHTML via a bundled scaffolder, then deploys pages to spaces or creates pre-filled Jira issues through MCP.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask to build org-wide templates, custom blueprints, page layouts, or automated content generation, and when modifying or managing existing templates.

say_en.text: Create a meeting notes template and generate storage-format XHTML.
say_en.note: Claude runs the scaffolder and shows output.

say_en.text: Deploy the project charter template to the Marketing Confluence space.
say_en.note: It fetches resources and creates the page via MCP.

say_en.text: Update the decision log template, keeping the old version.
say_en.note: It reads the current version before updating.
